Fitur ini tidak mendeteksi atau menjamin penghapusan SynthID, serta tidak menjamin seluruh kaidah EYD V. Sorotan, pemilihan saran, dan suntingan manual diproses di browser tanpa mengirim ulang teks. Saran mengikuti pilihan yang tersedia; tidak setiap perubahan memiliki alternatif tambahan. Masukan dan hasil tidak disimpan sebagai riwayat di server.
id.faq6A: Pembersihan karakter dan metadata tidak memakai model AI. PDF tidak mendapatkan OCR atau penulisan ulang isi. Pembersihan gambar tidak menghapus watermark pada piksel; audio dan video tidak diproses ulang. SVG tidak disanitasi dari skrip, dan LaTeX tidak dikompilasi. Dukungan FLAC terbatas pada ID3v2; metadata bawaan FLAC dan tag ID3v1 MP3 dapat tertinggal. Simpan berkas asli dan periksa hasilnya.

en.seoTitle: NoMark — Hidden Character & Document Metadata Cleaner
en.seoDescription: Clean hidden Unicode characters and metadata in documents, images, audio, and video. Everything except PDFs is processed in your browser, without accounts or AI APIs.
en.faq1A: NoMark cleans supported hidden Unicode characters and metadata in documents, images, audio, and video. It does not remove visible or audio-embedded watermarks and does not guarantee removal of statistical AI watermarks.
en.faq2Q: Do I need to install an app or use an AI API?
en.faq2A: No account, installation, API key, or MCP is required. Cleaning works without an AI model. Optional paraphrasing uses locally operated translation models on the NoMark server after your consent.
en.faq3A: For files, only PDFs are uploaded after consent. Text and other file cleaning runs in the browser. The separate Paraphrase tab sends text to the server after its own consent. History stays on your device.
en.faq4A: NoMark was created so anyone can use watermarks-remover to clean text in their browser without a complicated installation.

en.faq5Q: How do paraphrasing and suggestions work?
en.faq5A: Paraphrasing uses back-translation with local models on the NoMark server, without an external AI API. Conservative checks may preserve the original text. This does not detect or guarantee removal of SynthID or compliance with every language rule. Highlighting, suggestion choices, and manual edits run in your browser without resending text. Suggestions depend on the available choices; not every change has another alternative. Input and output are not saved as server history.
en.faq6Q: What are the limits of file cleaning?
en.faq6A: Character and metadata cleaning does not use an AI model. PDFs do not receive OCR or content rewriting. Image cleaning does not remove pixel watermarks; audio and video are not reprocessed. SVG scripts are not sanitized, and LaTeX is not compiled. FLAC support is limited to ID3v2; native FLAC metadata and MP3 ID3v1 tags may remain. Keep the originals and review the results.
